svg.title: Stop Condition Decision Tree
svg.desc: Vertical sequence of four stacked cards: 1 Observable — could someone else verify it? 2 Falsifiable — can it clearly fail? 3 Targets the real risk — does it catch what actually matters? 4 Ready to ship — all three criteria pass. Footer reads: if any answer is no, rewrite the stop condition.

svg.text: Define done before you start. Evidence beats confidence.
